title: Video tile covers the map's 2D/3D switch on a phone
description: An operator on a phone switches the map to 2D.
approach: Argus finds the 2D button, checks what element is actually on top at its centre, taps it with a real touch and verifies whether the map mode changed.

findings.title: On a phone the video tile covers the 2D/3D map switch, so tapping 2D does nothing
findings.detail: The 2D button's centre is covered by video-player; a real tap on it did not change the map mode.

steps: [  0.6s] Start: operator on a phone wants to switch the map to 2D
[  6.9s] Tap the 2D button where it is drawn
